en: Black-and-white postcard showing extensive war ruins in a town: collapsed buildings, a surviving arched doorway in the foreground, piles of rubble, and a tall, thin damaged tower or chimney at right. The printed French caption at the top describes destruction in Pargny-sur-Saulx during the First World War, specifically around the Battle of the Marne in September 1914. The publisher credit "Phot-Express" appears at the upper right.
